colorCustomizer.title: Adjust colours
colorCustomizer.tip: Some colours follow others to stay harmonious and readable: primary sets the accent, secondary sets the background, background sets the text. You can then fine-tune each one.
colorCustomizer.subtitle: Click a swatch or type a code. The preview updates live.
colorCustomizer.previewText: This is how your brand will look.
colorCustomizer.contrastGood: Text reads well on the background
colorCustomizer.contrastLow: Text is hard to read on the background
